title: Notice regarding non-availability of Hon'ble Mr.Justice N.S.Sanjay Gowda on 23.11.2026.
text:
KEY LINES:
Date: - 23/11/2026
It is hereby notified that on 23.11.2026;

FULL TEXT:
The High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: - 23/11/2026
N O T I C E
HCG-02/2026
It is hereby notified that on 23.11.2026;
(1) Hon’ble Mr. Justice N. S. Sanjay Gowda would not be
available for Judicial as well as Administrative work.
(2) Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Ms. Justice Sangeeta K.
Vishen and Hon’ble Mr. Justice J. L. Odedra) would take
up the matters notified in the Cause list of Hon’ble Court
(Coram : Hon’ble Mr. Justice N.S.Sanjay Gowda and
Hon’ble Mr. Justice J. L. Odedra.)
By Order of Hon’ble the Acting Chief Justice
Sd/-
Registrar (Judicial)
